claim_tested: Vasa motif residues required for ATP-dependent unwinding
key_finding: 2.2 A Vasa core with ssRNA + ATP analog; interdomain interactions couple ATP hydrolysis to RNA unwinding
context: Drosophila melanogaster Vasa 200-661 crystal structure PDB 2DB3
confidence_and_limitations: High for Vasa; transfer to GLH-2 is inference by alignment

key_finding: Q/I/Ia/GG/II/III/IVa/V/VI retained; 21/24 ATP-contact and 15/21 RNA-contact residues identical to Vasa
context: UniProt Q966L9 aligned to Vasa 202-621 (NW BLOSUM62)

claim_tested: GLH-2 core adopts the Vasa fold
key_finding: phenix.superpose_pdbs RMSD 1.118 A over 311 matching atoms; core pLDDT 84.5
context: AlphaFold AF-Q966L9-F1 v6 vs 2DB3 chain A

key_finding: 62/98 RecA1-RecA2 interface residues identical to Vasa; all motif-borne interface residues intact
confidence_and_limitations: Interface identity lower than DDX4 (77%) at peripheral positions

claim_tested: Motifs Ib and IV are degenerate in GLH-2
key_finding: Ib TPGR to TVGR and IV ETKR to SQRA; same in GLH-1/GLH-3/GLH-4 but not LAF-1/VBH-1/Vasa/DDX4

claim_tested: GLH helicase core is functional in vivo
key_finding: GLH-1 helicase activity required to retain association with P granules; 28 endogenous CRISPR alleles
confidence_and_limitations: In vivo inference; paralog GLH-1 not GLH-2

claim_tested: GLH-1 binds and hydrolyses ATP in vivo
key_finding: GLH-1 couples distinct steps of its ATP hydrolysis cycle to P granule formation and disassembly
confidence_and_limitations: In vivo inference; no purified-protein kinetics

claim_tested: GLH ATPase cycle is functional and gates partner binding
key_finding: ATPase cycle of GLH-1 regulates direct binding to Argonaute WAGO-1; GLH proteins bind Argonaute target mRNAs
context: C. elegans germ granules; GLH family incl. GLH-2
confidence_and_limitations: Source of the GLH-1 GO:0003724 IDA; activity inferred in vivo

key_finding: LOTUS domains bind and stimulate the germline DEAD-box helicase Vasa; conservation is wide
context: Drosophila Vasa + Oskar LOTUS crystal and in vitro assays
confidence_and_limitations: Implies basal Vasa activity is low; GLH-2 activity may require LOTUS partners (MIP-1/MIP-2, PMID:34223818)

claim_tested: C. elegans has LOTUS regulators of GLH
key_finding: MIP-1 and MIP-2 LOTUS proteins bind and anchor GLH-1 in P granules
confidence_and_limitations: Shown for GLH-1; GLH-2 binding not separately demonstrated

claim_tested: Is GLH-2 catalysis required in vivo?
key_finding: glh-2 deletion is not essential; GLH-1 is the key family member
context: C. elegans deletion alleles of all four glh genes
confidence_and_limitations: Non-essentiality does not refute catalysis, but removes a phenotypic test

key_finding: GLH-2 is a putative germline RNA helicase with six CCHC fingers localized to P granules
confidence_and_limitations: Sole experimental reference behind the GLH-2 GO record; no catalytic assay

key_finding: Nematode Vasa shows clade-specific duplications and sequence divergence
confidence_and_limitations: Supports the clade-wide interpretation of the Ib and IV substitutions
